landing.heroBody: A widow who cannot read applies by voice on a weak signal. The system acts alone only when the evidence clears a bar set by the cost of a mistake. Otherwise an officer gets the case, the reason, and the one fact that would settle it.
landing.promo: Synthetic data · no real money moves
landing.howTitle: AI reads. Mocks confirm. Rules decide. People sign off.

steps.d: Voice answers and document photos become structured facts, with a confidence for every field.
Identity, civil registry and wallet checks run against labelled mock government systems.
Auto-approve only when the evidence clears a bar set by what a mistake would cost. Everything else escalates.
An officer sees the reason and the single fact that would settle the case, then decides.

landing.roleCitizenD: Answer by voice or icons. Works on a weak signal. Answers wait safely on the phone.
landing.roleHelperD: Help someone in your community apply, with drafts they can review and confirm.
landing.roleStaffD: Officer queue, admin rules and twin, and the auditor's chain checks.

feats.d: Every step can be heard and answered without reading.
Answers are saved on the phone and sent when the signal returns, with ticks that show where each one is.
Every decision is chained. The auditor can see exactly where a chain would break.
Admins can slow, fail or attack the mock services and watch the system hold.
Reports about fake officers and fee demands land in one queue with the evidence.
Read the codes and messages a citizen would get. No real SMS is ever sent.

landing.ctaTitle: See it work end to end
landing.ctaBody: Citizens apply with a phone code and PIN. Staff sign in with their own email and password.
landing.footer: Prototype for Coder's Cup '26. Every person, document and government system here is synthetic or a labelled mock.
